title: 本周英文小测（示例）
subtitle: 示例题，不是你问过的词

questions.prompt: 多元无知：每个人私下都不认同某个规范，却以为别人都认同，于是都跟着做
questions.note: 社会心理学术语。在新闻里第一次出现时要紧跟一句白话解释，别指望读者知道。
a one-size-fits-all AI policy 常带贬义。blanket ban 专指“全面禁止”。

questions.prompt: Many professors expressed that they are worried about students using AI.
questions.answer: Many professors said they worry about students' use of AI.
alternatives: Many professors voiced concern about students using AI.
questions.note: express 后面不能直接跟 that 从句。新闻里默认用 said，voiced concern 是可以替换的地道说法。

questions.prompt: The psychology department let students help ____ the course's AI policy, rather than handing it down from above.
questions.note: shape a policy 是固定搭配，意思是参与塑造、影响政策。make up 更像“编造”或“组成”。

questions.prompt: In a straight news story, which verb is the neutral default for attributing a quote?
questions.note: AP 风格：said 是中性的。claimed 暗示你不信，admitted 暗示对方认错，stated 显得生硬。
